joint_metric.reason: The three test populations (crop recs, enriched yield district×year rows, seed viability) still describe unrelated samples: no shared plot / farm / sample_id join key exists. Per-crop alignment (join on Crop name) would pair a 'Rice soil NPK rec' row with a 'Rice Karnataka district-year' yield row — different populations, not the same underlying observation.  Reporting a joint rate would be fabrication.

component_marginals_independence_bound.note: Assumes independence across components — NOT a measurement.

joint_metric.target_achievable_given_components: NO — even a perfect yield model + unchanged crop 99.32% + unchanged seed 90.00% → independence product 89.39% < 90%. Genuinely reaching 90% requires field-level data where all three labels are measured on the SAME plot and at least one of crop / seed is improved to ≥95% with the yield within ±25% condition holding.
